module_summary: Source-side storage of a CDC gray FIFO: register array written at src_widx_i on src_write_i, exported whole to the destination domain.

anchors.name: data_q
anchors.why: FIFO entry array, loaded on src_write_i, read asynchronously by destination

anchors.name: src_widx_i
anchors.why: Write pointer selecting which entry receives src_data_i

anchors.name: src_write_i
anchors.why: Write enable loading data_q with updated entry

anchors.name: src_data_i
anchors.why: Write payload stored into indexed FIFO entry

anchors.name: async_data_o
anchors.why: Entire FIFO array exported across clock domain

groups.name: fifo_storage
groups.description: Indexed write into register array exported to destination domain
